[SWS_PER_00275]
⌈
When an existing key of a Key-Value Storage can
be associated with a PersistencyKeyValueDatabaseInterface.dataElement
or PersistencyKeyValueDatabase.keyValuePair in an updated manifest, and
the update strategy is overwrite, the Persistency shall replace the entry in the
Key-Value Storage with the new type and value as specified in [SWS_PER_00254]
and [SWS_PER_00384].
